title: How is Al Capone connected to Scooby-Doo?
description:
Nine real pictures connect gangster Al Capone to Scooby-Doo, through baseball legends, Marilyn Monroe, the Kennedys and Robin Williams.

Al Capone → Gabby Hartnett → Rogers Hornsby → Joe DiMaggio → Marilyn Monroe → John F. Kennedy → Ted Kennedy → Robin Williams → Sarah Michelle Gellar → Scooby-Doo

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
